reuse.why: The change reuses bank lookup, syncing, and closed-account validation, but copies provider workflows and bypasses the shared duplicate-link guard in two handlers.

duplication.why: Fintegra duplicates existing linking and download workflows, while releaseLinks duplicates unlinkAccount's local field-clearing block.

placement.why: Provider requests, transaction downloads, configuration, and model types remain in their established layers.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested linking policies, Fintegra integration, and associated release note.

maintainability.why: Provider-specific bypasses and additional workflow copies leave maintainers multiple places to update shared linking policies and unlink state.

bypasses_abstraction.where: In accounts/app.ts, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount call findLinkedElsewhere conditionally instead of routing through assertNotLinkedElsewhere.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions reproduce existing provider workflows under Fintegra names and configuration.

abstraction_drift.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere gains replaceExistingLink and conditional refusal, while the Akahu and Enable Banking handlers implement their own conditional lookup paths around that policy.
